evidence.detail: The class owns an independent pixel buffer, width/height, clip bounds and row-offset state and extends R55 DrawingArea.
Its static API implements clip reset/set, horizontal and vertical line drawing, bordered rectangles, alpha/filled primitives and general integer line rasterization with Bresenham-style stepping.
R55 RSFont invokes the class directly for inline strike/line rendering while drawing text; no unrelated domain state is owned.
Public RSPS client lineage uses the Rasterizer2D noun for this software 2D pixel/clip/drawing primitive role while retaining DrawingArea-era compatibility classes.

candidates.note: Exact-v308 software 2D rasterizer. DrawingArea remains a distinct older/base class; no invented qualifier is added.
